She has a shoulder-length platinum-blonde bob with soft bangs and wears a glossy two-tone competitive one-piece swimsuit with a royal-blue center panel and bubblegum-pink side panels. Keep her stance upright and relaxed, with subtle wet hair and water droplets suggesting recent swimming.
